simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to הוֹמָם (H1950) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.

simple.summary: הוֹמָם (Hôwmâm) means Homam , an Edomitish chieftain First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 39.

definitions.full: H1950. Homam הוֺמָם proper name see below המם . הוֺמָ֑ם proper name, masculine son of Seir the Horite 1Chr 1:39 ᵐ5 Αίμαν ᵐ5 L Ημαν ; = הֵימָ֑ם Gen 36:22 . [ הָמַן ] verb rage, be trubulent (? denominative from המון Thes, after Rabb; compare Ke RV; AV multiply ; but very dubious) — only Qal Infinitive suffix מִןהַֿגּוֺיִם הֲמָנְכֶם יַעַן Ezek 5:7 (Sm queries; Ew, after ᵑ6 Aq, הִמָּנֵכֶם from מנה ); read rather, with Bö Co Da, המרותכם (from מרה ) because ye rebelled.
